rationale: Met Police War Crimes Team submitted full evidence files to the UK Crown Prosecution Service on two of six Rwandan genocide suspects by Dec 2025; resolution_date 2026-09-21 (< Dec 31) confirms CPS announces charges on Sept 21. Four named suspects interviewed in 2020 are prime candidates: Celestin Mutabaruka, Emmanuel Nteziryayo, Celestin Ugirashebuja, and Vincent Bajinya (legally renamed Vincent Brown in UK; split 0.12/0.10 across both name forms). Charles Munyaneza had a stroke/late 2024 interview and a 6th Gateshead suspect is unnamed (~0.18 combined outside top 5).
